notes.title: Addictive Text-based Military themed MMO RPG Coming soon to Steam !
notes.content:
https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/33558674/8f1b4200aeac15645dac5cdb9fd59c482806aebe.png

After a great success in other platforms, BattleCry: World At War is making its way to Steam. 

We aim to redefine the way the Text-Based games are played! 

BattleCry: World At War is a Text-Based online multiplayer role-playing game (Yeah, you heard it right!) where you team up with other players to build your military might and dominate the battlefield. 

Increase your influence and firepower by recruiting and expanding your army, navy, air-force and most importantly Captains to lead them. There's opportunity in every front and make sure you take the right decisions.

Join and Coordinate your strategies with your Alliance and fellow commanders by using our new chat system where you can communicate in real time.

The fun and opportunities are endless!
